body:
## Summary
- Add a dedicated accessibility description for the disabled Internet "Connect preview" action when no Internet profile is available.
- Route Internet connect enable/disable updates through one helper so the button label and accessibility reason stay synchronized.
- Keep verification in JVM source-contract coverage after rebasing onto PR #734; the prior `MainActivity` instrumentation case was removed so this change does not restore Activity, network, or permission side effects to the no-Host suite.

## Verification
- PASS: `cd baseline/AndroidClient && ./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.MainActivityTerminalGuidanceContractTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.ClientExperienceTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.ConnectionGuidanceTest`
- PASS: `cd baseline/AndroidClient && ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug auditReleaseDependencies` (1713 JVM tests; one socket timing test failed once, then passed alone and the complete rerun passed)
- PASS: `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD`
- PASS: `ConnectionStateAccessibilityInstrumentedTest` contains no `ActivityScenario`, `MainActivity::class`, or `phase3_internet_profile` preference mutation after the rebase.

## Scope and gate notes
- This is Android no-Host UI/UX work only. It does not run `swift run`, start or inspect the macOS Host, touch Screen Recording / Accessibility / Microphone / Keychain / System Settings, or create `adb reverse tcp:54321`.
- This does not claim or close any Host-backed E2E evidence, Android/macOS clipboard product E2E, file-transfer product E2E, or Phase 0 stable-release blocked gates.
title: fix(android): explain disabled internet connect action
